Planning requires approved Requirement and actual repository context; a revision must record task-impact mapping; the plan remains a candidate until independent verification and separate human gates.

May create or update only a specifically authorized candidate in the current attempt; cannot modify approved/superseded Plan or source implementation; stops before independent verification and human approval.

The planning Request must be populated; current approved Requirement and repository context must be established; a candidate update needs explicit current-attempt authorization; this process cannot perform verification or approval.
Plan verification and resolution precede Human Review Approval, Human Plan Approval, and implementation.
Plan findings follow the governed corrective route; durable records require an adopted root, stable Work ID, actor-owned scope, stage authorization and no-overwrite publication.
Each actor publishes only its own records, must record and validate current invocation context before consequential work, and cannot create or revise human decisions.
